'''Chris Beaulieu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Boston Grand Slam]] on 8 April 2000 with Hidden Base with asteroids, according to Paul Maholick's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d494">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-milford-mass-grand-slam-4-8-00d494/ milford-mass-grand-slam-4-8-00], DeckTech (Paul "Paul" Maholick, 10 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-milford-mass-grand-slam-4-8-00d494/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
